Approximate leave-future-out cross-validation of fitted mvgam objects

Source: R/lfo_cv.mvgam.R
lfo_cv.mvgam.Rd

Scores a model on its forecasts. The model is fitted to the times up to min_t and scored on the next fc_horizon observed times. The origin then steps forward one time at a time. Pareto smoothed importance sampling (PSIS) reweights the posterior to each new origin. The model is refitted only where the Pareto k exceeds pareto_k_threshold. The algorithm is that of Burkner, Gabry and Vehtari (2020), as in the loo PSIS-LFO vignette.

The ELPD of each fold is higher for the better model. CRPS and the other scores of score.mvgam_forecast() are lower for the better model. loo.mvgam() explains the ELPD and the Pareto k diagnostic.

Usage

lfo_cv(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'mvgam'
lfo_cv(
  object,
  newdata = NULL,
  min_t = NULL,
  fc_horizon = 1L,
  pareto_k_threshold = NULL,
  score = "elpd",
  save_log_lik = FALSE,
  silent = 1L,
  ...,
  data = NULL
)

Arguments

object

A fitted mvgam object.

...

Unused. Anything passed here is refused.

newdata

Optional data.frame holding the response, the time and series columns and the covariates. NULL (the default) takes the training data. Every series must share its observed times, except under CAR(), whose series may be observed at their own times.

min_t

The time at which the first training window ends. It must be a time present in the data, which need not be whole for an irregular CAR() grid. NULL (the default) takes the 30th observed time, earlier for a shorter series, leaving at least 10 evaluation origins where the data allow.

fc_horizon

Integer number of observed times after each origin that are scored, whatever the gaps between them. Defaults to 1.

pareto_k_threshold

Numeric. An origin whose Pareto k exceeds it triggers a refit. NULL (the default) takes the adaptive threshold min(1 - 1 / log10(S), 0.7) for S posterior draws (Vehtari et al. 2024). It is stricter for a fit with few draws, where PSIS is less reliable.

score

Character vector of scores to compute at each origin, from "elpd" (the default), "crps", "drps", "sis", "brier", "energy" and "variogram". The ELPD takes the PSIS log-likelihood. The others score forecast draws resampled by the PSIS weights, with score.mvgam_forecast().

save_log_lik

Logical. TRUE keeps the held-out log densities under the reweighted posterior, an [ndraws, n_eval_obs] matrix. loo_model_weights.mvgam_lfo() stacks models by it. Defaults to FALSE, the matrix being large.

silent

Integer in \{0, 1, 2\}. 0 prints each refit and its sampler start and finish lines. 1 (default) and 2 print nothing from the refits.

data

Deprecated alias for newdata.

Value

A list of class mvgam_lfo, with one element per origin in each vector.

  • elpds: the approximate ELPD of each origin, NULL unless "elpd" is in score. sum_ELPD is their sum.

  • scores: a named list with one vector for each other score.

  • pareto_ks: the Pareto k of each origin's importance weights, NA where the model was refitted.

  • eval_timepoints: the first scored time of each origin.

  • n_obs: the number of responses each origin scores.

  • refits_at: the last training time of each refit.

  • refit_triggered: TRUE at each origin scored on a refit.

  • pareto_k_threshold: the threshold used. TRUE in pareto_k_threshold_adaptive marks the adaptive rule.

  • fc_horizon: the horizon.

  • log_lik: the held-out log densities when save_log_lik = TRUE, otherwise NULL.

References

Burkner, P.-C., Gabry, J. and Vehtari, A. (2020). Approximate leave-future-out cross-validation for Bayesian time series models. Journal of Statistical Computation and Simulation, 90(14):2499-2523. doi:10.1080/00949655.2020.1783262

Vehtari, A., Simpson, D., Gelman, A., Yao, Y. and Gabry, J. (2024). Pareto smoothed importance sampling. Journal of Machine Learning Research, 25(72):1-58. https://jmlr.org/papers/v25/19-556.html

See also

loo_compare.mvgam_lfo() ranks models by their leave-future-out ELPD. loo_model_weights.mvgam_lfo() weights them. loo.mvgam() approximates leave-one-out cross-validation. kfold.mvgam() runs grouped k-fold cross-validation. The forecast evaluation article runs lfo_cv() on rodent counts, with its Pareto k refits and stacking weights.

Other forecasting: compare_scores(), ensemble.mvgam_forecast(), forecast.mvgam(), hindcast.mvgam(), score.mvgam_forecast()

Other model comparison: bridge_sampler.mvgam(), compare_elpds(), kfold.mvgam(), log_lik.mvgam(), loo.mvgam(), loo_compare.mvgam_lfo(), mvgam_loo_extras, posterior_average.mvgam(), waic.mvgam()

Examples

# \dontrun{
set.seed(11)
simdat <- sim_mvgam(family = poisson(), n_series = 1L,
                     n_timepoints = 120L, trend_model = AR())

mod <- mvgam(
  y ~ s(x, k = 5),
  trend_formula = ~ AR(p = 1),
  data    = simdat$data_train,
  family  = poisson(),
  chains  = 2, silent = 2
)
#> Warning: 36 of 2000 (2.0%) transitions ended with a divergence.
#> See https://mc-stan.org/misc/warnings for details.

# Forecasts one time step after each origin from t = 60, scored by
# ELPD and CRPS. The model is refitted only where the Pareto k is high.
lfo <- lfo_cv(mod, min_t = 60L, score = c("elpd", "crps"))
#> Warning: 38 of 2000 (2.0%) transitions ended with a divergence.
#> See https://mc-stan.org/misc/warnings for details.
#> Warning: 54 of 2000 (3.0%) transitions ended with a divergence.
#> See https://mc-stan.org/misc/warnings for details.
#> Warning: 22 of 2000 (1.0%) transitions ended with a divergence.
#> See https://mc-stan.org/misc/warnings for details.
#> Warning: 19 of 2000 (1.0%) transitions ended with a divergence.
#> See https://mc-stan.org/misc/warnings for details.
#> Warning: 6 of 2000 (0.0%) transitions ended with a divergence.
#> See https://mc-stan.org/misc/warnings for details.
lfo
#> Approximate leave-future-out cross-validation
#>   fc_horizon         : 1
#>   pareto_k_threshold : 0.697 (adaptive)
#>   evaluation points  : 30
#>   refits             : 5
#>   ELPD               : sum = -78.96, mean = -2.63
#>   crps               : sum = 57.91, mean = 1.93

# Pareto k, ELPD and CRPS at each origin. Points past the dashed
# line are highlighted
plot(lfo)


# One row per origin, with the refits in 'refit_here'
summary(lfo)
#> # A tibble: 30 × 6
#>    eval_time refit_here pareto_k n_obs  elpd  crps
#>        <int> <lgl>         <dbl> <int> <dbl> <dbl>

#>  7        67 FALSE       -0.0401     1 -2.78 3.21
